import hashlib
import json

from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

def rota(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output([\"python3\", \"rota.py\", *args], text=True)

original = Path(\"data/rota.json\").read_bytes()
print(\"SHA-256:\", hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())
before = rota(\"day\", \"wed\")
assert before == \"M-14\\t09:10\\tХор\\n\", repr(before)
print(\"Ведомость до правки:\", repr(before))
with TemporaryDirectory(dir=\".\") as temp:
    copy = Path(temp, \"rota.json\")
    copy.write_bytes(original)
    roster = (\"--roster\", str(copy))
    initial = rota(*roster, \"lead\", \"E-23\").strip()
    confirmation = rota(*roster, \"assign\", \"E-23\", \"Анна\").strip()
    persisted = next(row[\"lead\"] for row in json.loads(copy.read_bytes())[\"rehearsals\"] if row[\"id\"] == \"E-23\")
    reloaded = rota(*roster, \"lead\", \"E-23\").strip()
    print(\"E-23: исходное имя, подтверждение, имя в файле, повторное чтение:\", initial, confirmation, persisted, reloaded)
    assert (initial, confirmation, persisted, reloaded) == (\"Ирина\", \"Анна\", \"Ирина\", \"Ирина\")
assert Path(\"data/rota.json\").read_bytes() == original
PY"

changed_file_contents.rota.py:
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read the rehearsal rota")
    parser.add_argument("--roster", type=Path, default=Path("data/rota.json"))
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("day").add_argument("weekday")
    sub.add_parser("lead").add_argument("event")
    assign = sub.add_parser("assign")
    assign.add_argument("event")
    assign.add_argument("name")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    schedule = json.loads(args.roster.read_text())
    rehearsals = schedule["rehearsals"]
    if args.action == "day":
        for event in sorted(rehearsals, key=lambda row: row["time"]):
            if event["weekday"] == args.weekday:
                print(f'{event["id"]}\t{event["time"]}\t{event["title"]}')
        return
    event = next((row for row in rehearsals if row["id"] == args.event), None)
    if event is None:
        parser.exit(2, f"Unknown rehearsal: {args.event}\n")
    if args.action == "lead":
        print(event["lead"])
        return
    change = event.copy()
    change["lead"] = args.name
    args.roster.write_text(json.dumps(schedule, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(change["lead"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
